engineer.name: Christelle Mamekem Ngueguim
engineer.title: Senior Software Engineer (.NET C# / Java EE / Angular / DevOps)
engineer.introduction: Senior Software Engineer with 10+ years of expertise spanning Backend Engineering (.NET Core/C# & Java/Spring Boot), Frontend SPAs (Angular & React), QA Testing, Fullstack architecture, and System/Infrastructure Management. Proven record engineering secure microservices with JWT/Keycloak, integrating enterprise middleware (RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, OpenKM), architecting PEPPOL e-invoicing standards (UBL 2.1 & Schematron), and orchestrating automated DevOps pipelines with Docker, Ansible, Azure DevOps, and GitLab CI.

experiences.description: Delivered a PEPPOL-compliant e-invoicing platform under strict regulatory deadlines, enabling clients to meet EU mandates. Built the integration layer with Flowin API, designed XML/UBL 2.1 validation pipelines, and established CI/CD automation to ensure rapid, reliable delivery.
achievements: Met a critical government-mandated deadline by architecting and implementing the full PEPPOL integration via Flowin API—enabling the first client to register on the PEPPOL network and avoid regulatory penalties.
Eliminated invoice rejection risks by engineering a custom XML/UBL 2.1 mapping engine with Schematron validation, ensuring 100% of outbound invoices conformed to PEPPOL standards before transmission.
Enabled rapid client onboarding for multiple tenants by building modular Angular 18 frontends with Signals and scalable Java 17 / Spring Boot microservices.

Reduced deployment cycles from days to minutes by implementing a fully automated CI/CD pipeline (GitLab CI, SonarQube, Nexus) that enforced quality gates, automated testing, and zero-touch deployments across dev, test, and production environments.
Secured business continuity by designing and deploying Ansible backup automation for Nexus, Open Project, GitLab, EspoCRM, and WordPress—enabling rapid restoration of critical systems and data.

experiences.description: Led the modernization and delivery of a commercial ERP system from legacy code to a modern, multi-tenant SaaS platform—upgrading Angular 12 to 14+, refactoring .NET Core microservices, and meeting tight client deadlines with a distributed team.
achievements: Architected a multi-tenant SaaS system using a tenant-suffix login strategy (similar to @company.com) to identify organizations at authentication, combined with an OrganizationID column in all database tables for data isolation. Every data access interface enforced OrganizationID as a mandatory parameter to prevent cross-tenant data leakage.
Implemented rigorous automated testing and mandatory code review checks to mitigate the risk of developer error, ensuring tenant isolation was consistently enforced across the system.

Acknowledged performance trade-offs—the OrganizationID approach adds query overhead for read-heavy modules. Proposed alternative strategies including separate schemas per tenant and materialized views to improve scalability.

Took ownership of a legacy ERP codebase and successfully upgraded the entire Angular frontend from version 12 to 14+ while preparing the product for its first production release—meeting all client-imposed deadlines.

Rapidly mastered .NET Core/C# to refactor the existing backend, then designed and delivered 4 new microservices (Configuration, Sales, Accounting, Stock) for the multi-tenant SaaS system—ensuring the product was ready for market launch on schedule.

Led and mentored a distributed Agile team of 2 developers across time zones; conducted PR reviews, managed sprint planning on Azure DevOps, and maintained technical documentation to enable smooth collaboration and knowledge transfer.

Designed and published a reusable Angular component library based on Angular Material—enabling rapid UI development, ensuring visual consistency across the entire application, and improving maintainability. The library was versioned and distributed via Azure Feed (private npm registry).

Extended and maintained the existing Azure Pipelines to include the 4 new microservices I built—ensuring that every validated PR triggered a seamless deployment to IIS, eliminating manual deployment errors and accelerating release cycles.

Delivered a complete reporting suite by integrating jsPDF client-side document generation for receipts and reports, and implementing ClosedXML for automated Excel exports—reducing manual reporting time by 70%.

experiences.description: Led the transformation of a desktop ERP into a web-based SaaS platform with a unified reporting module, enabling business owners to monitor profitability across multiple enterprises.
achievements: Developed and maintained 3+ core modules (School, Hospital, Accounting) for the 'Nkap' ERP suite using Java Spring and Groovy/Grails—serving multiple enterprises.

Designed a multi-tenant SaaS reporting module that consolidated data from multiple systems via Pentaho ETL and ActiveMQ messaging, giving business owners a unified view of margins and profitability across their diverse operations.
Orchestrated integration of enterprise middleware including OpenKM for document management, Keycloak for SSO/IAM, and ActiveMQ for reliable cross-service messaging.
Established automated testing (JUnit/Mockito, Jasmine/Protractor) and containerized applications with Docker on VPS for consistent deployment.

Deployed Prometheus and Grafana monitoring stacks to track Docker container health, resource usage, and application performance across multiple VPS environments, enabling proactive incident detection and capacity planning.
Managed the full infrastructure lifecycle—from Linux VPS security hardening with Ansible to automated backups, domain management, and internal tool deployment (Nexus, EspoCRM).
